# Project Copilot Instructions

- Use JavaScript only in this project.
- Use `.js` for JavaScript files.
- Use `.jsx` only when JSX specifically requires it.
- Never create `.ts` or `.tsx` files.
- Use the Next.js App Router.
- Keep the existing project structure, styling, functionality, and dependencies unchanged.
- Do not convert or rewrite existing working files unnecessarily.
- Before creating a new file, check the existing project structure to avoid duplicate files.
- Do not make unrelated changes to the application.
